text: Based on the tool outputs, we can confirm that the forest has been largely intact since 2020. The observations show that there was tree cover in 2000 and that 91.77% of the asset was forest in 2020, according to the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset. The Hansen Global Forest Change data also supports this, with valid data covering the entire area. There are no indications of significant deforestation or changes in forest cover since 2020.
